context: Aoi runs a customer-feedback session at the cafe with regular customers.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 皆さん、ご提案、ありがとうございます。
lines.en: Thank you all so much for your suggestions.
lines.style: Gracious and genuine. Warm, measured pace. Slight lift at the acknowledgement — not performative, just real gratitude. Open posture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 感想、お客さんから、ようけ集まったな。
lines.en: We've gotten a lot of feedback from customers, haven't we.
lines.style: Soft Kansai warmth. Conspiratorial tone — shared appreciation. Slight smile in the voice. Relaxed, almost casual despite the formality of the moment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: サービスの改善、すぐ対応します。
lines.en: I'll work on improving the service right away.
lines.style: Quiet resolve. Calm, measured delivery. Slight pause before the commitment — not hesitant, just deliberate. Taking it seriously but not heavy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to seeing how it goes.
lines.style: Kansai lilt at the end — genuine curiosity without pressure. Warm, engaged. Light pace. The sound of someone who actually means it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: I want to keep trying new things.
lines.style: Tender undertone. Soft, earnest. Slight vulnerability — admitting ambition without over-stating it. Gentle trailing-off, like she's speaking partly to herself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: お前の店、皆、応援してる。
lines.en: Everyone here is rooting for your shop.
lines.style: Warm Kansai directness. Firm but affectionate — the kind of reassurance that lands because it's not sugar-coated. Low, steady tone. Pride in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Thank you. That really warms my heart.
lines.style: Soft, genuine relief. Voice opens slightly on the gratitude. Slow pace. Almost touched — the kind of moment where she lets her guard down just a fraction.
